summary.maximum_defensible_claim: Exploratory approximate-section cluster-union agreement in two cores; no unbiased cancer classifier accuracy or population superiority claim.
summary.metric: Dice/F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); all predicted footprint outside outlined regions is FP
summary.registration: Geometry-only similarity, independently visually reviewed; approximate, not pixel-exact
summary.selection: Oracle selects on the scored core; cross-core transfer selects on the other core. All resolutions and seeds retained.
